goal: Dinamikus MCP tool discovery: agent-ek runtime-ban publikálnak tool-okat, tool versioning (semver), composable tool chain-ek, per-tool metrikák + timeout/retry.

phases.name: Phase 1: Dynamic Tool Registry
tasks: [ ] MCP server auto-publish: registerAllTools() → dynamic migrálás

phases.name: Phase 2: Versioning & Compatibility
tasks: [ ] Version resolution: agent kér tool@^1.0.0 → legújabb kompatibilis
[ ] Deprecation support: tool deprecated → warning + fallback

phases.name: Phase 3: Tool Composition
tasks: [ ] ComposableTool: chain definíció (tool1 output → tool2 input)
[ ] Schema kompatibilitás check: output schema ⊆ input schema
[ ] Macro tool-ok: több tool → egy composit tool
[ ] Tool recommendation: feladat alapján javasolt tool-ok

phases.name: Phase 4: Metrics + Dashboard + CLI
tasks: [ ] Per-tool metrikák: call count, avg latency, error rate, last used
[ ] CLI: brunella tools (list, info, chain, metrics)

expectedOutput: npm run build && npm test → 0 hiba
